title: Gameplay Tips
disclaimer: These are practical prompts derived from the cited SRD rules. They do not add or override rules.

tips.title: State a clear intent
tips.advice: Describe what your character tries to do and how they approach it before asking for a roll.

tips.title: Lead with a relevant strength
tips.advice: Frame an approach around the ability that best matches the action: force, agility, endurance, reasoning, awareness, or presence.

tips.title: Let the roll resolve uncertainty
tips.advice: Roll when the GM calls for a D20 Test, then use the result to move the scene forward rather than repeat the same attempt unchanged.

tips.title: Check the specific feature
tips.advice: When a feature or spell seems to alter a baseline rule, read its wording because a specific exception can take precedence.
